faqs.question: Can I create a free business profile?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can create a free business profile and register on Check A Review at no cost to manage your reputation and respond to customer reviews.

faqs.question: Are prices billed monthly or annually?
faqs.answer: Prices are shown per month in GBP and billed monthly. Creating a free business profile does not require a paid plan.

faqs.question: Does Plus include a free trial?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plus includes a 14-day free trial for new customers before monthly billing begins.

faqs.question: How do I get Premium?
faqs.answer: Choose Premium from the business portal subscription page and complete Square checkout.

faqs.question: Can I change plans later?
faqs.answer: Yes. Upgrade any time from the business portal. Downgrading to Free cancels the paid Square subscription.
